name: gasrescue-mcp

tools.name: gasrescue_info
tools.description: Lists what gasrescue supports: the chains, the stablecoins on each, which chains can swap into their gas coin, the fees and the limits. Use gasrescue when a wallet holds USDC, USDT or USDG but no ETH, SOL, TRX or HYPE for the network fee ("insufficient funds for gas"). Call this first to get the chain keys and token symbols the other tools expect. Read-only, takes no input. Returns network, fees (service percent, minimum, maximum), limits (USD per transfer, transfers per wallet per day, quote validity) and the chains with their tokens and gas coin.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Checks one address on every supported chain where it is valid: which stablecoins it holds, its gas balance, whether the stablecoins are stuck (not enough gas to move them) and whether a token is frozen by its issuer. Use it before quote_send or quote_swap to find the chain and token to rescue. A frozen token cannot be moved by any tool here; only the issuer can lift that. Read-only: nothing is signed, sent or stored. Returns { address, chains: [{ key, label, native, tokens: [{ symbol, balance, frozen }], gas, stuck, frozen, canSwap }] }; a chain that did not answer has error: true.

address.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

annotations.title: Check a wallet for stuck stablecoins

tools.name: quote_send
tools.description: Prices sending USDC, USDT or USDG from a wallet without gas (no ETH, SOL or TRX) to another address, e.g. an exchange deposit or another wallet. Use quote_swap instead when the user wants gas in the same wallet. Creates a free quote, valid for 10 minutes; nothing moves on chain until the wallet signs it. Returns { summary, transfer }: the transfer id, network and service fee, what the recipient gets (net) and status "quoted". Show the summary to the user and get approval before signing. Fails with a readable error when the amount is outside $2 to $1,000 (Tron: from $10), the wallet holds too little, the token is frozen, or the wallet sent 10 transfers in 24 hours.

token.description: Stablecoin symbol, e.g. "USDC", "USDT", "USDT0" or "USDG". gasrescue_info lists what each chain supports.

sender.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

recipient.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

amount.description: Amount of the token, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "12.5". Fees come out of it.

tools.name: quote_swap
tools.description: Prices swapping a stablecoin into the chain's gas coin (ETH, SOL, HYPE) or another stablecoin, for a wallet without gas, so it can pay its own fees again. The result always goes back to the same wallet; use quote_send to pay someone else. Not available on Tron. Creates a free quote, valid for 2 minutes because prices move; nothing moves on chain until the wallet signs it. Returns { summary, transfer } with the transfer id, fees, the expected output and the minimum output (below it the swap reverts and nothing moves). Show the summary to the user and get approval before signing.

token.description: Stablecoin symbol, e.g. "USDC", "USDT", "USDT0" or "USDG". gasrescue_info lists what each chain supports.

tokenOut.description: What to get: the gas coin ("ETH", "SOL", "HYPE") or another stablecoin. gasrescue_info lists what each chain can buy.

sender.description: Wallet address: 0x… for EVM chains, base58 for Solana, T… for Tron.

amount.description: Amount of the token, as a decimal string, e.g. "25" or "12.5". Fees come out of it.

annotations.title: Quote a swap into gas without gas

tools.name: get_signing_request
tools.description: Returns what the sender's wallet has to sign for a quote from quote_send or quote_swap. kind "evm-typed-data": sign every steps[].typedData with eth_signTypedData_v4, in order; binding is the order the authorization commits to, so recipient, fee and minimum can be checked first. kind "tron-transactions": sign every steps[].transaction (first the fee, then the transfer). kind "solana-transaction" or "solana-versioned-transaction": sign the base64 transaction. Read-only. Pass the result to submit_signatures. Fails when the quote expired; then request a new quote.

transferId.description: The transfer id returned by quote_send or quote_swap (24 hex characters).

annotations.title: Get what the wallet must sign

tools.name: submit_signatures
tools.description: Submits the wallet's signatures for a quote; gasrescue broadcasts the transaction, pays the gas and waits up to 3 minutes for the result. This moves funds and cannot be undone: call it only after the user approved the quote summary. A transfer can be submitted once; a second call is refused. Give signatures for EVM and Tron, or signedTransaction for Solana. Returns { summary, transfer } with status confirmed or failed, the transaction hash and the explorer link.

transferId.description: The transfer id returned by quote_send or quote_swap (24 hex characters).

signatures.description: EVM and Tron: one signature per step of get_signing_request, in the same order, as hex strings.

signedTransaction.description: Solana only: the transaction from get_signing_request, signed by the sender, base64.

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: Returns the current state of a quote or transfer by its id: quoted, submitting, sent, confirmed, failed or expired, with the fees, the transaction hash and the explorer link once sent. Use it to follow up after submit_signatures or to see whether a quote is still open. Read-only. Returns { summary, transfer }.

transferId.description: The transfer id returned by quote_send or quote_swap (24 hex characters).

instructions: gasrescue moves stablecoins (USDC, USDT, USDG) out of a wallet that has no gas, or swaps them into the gas coin. Typical flow: check_wallet, then quote_send or quote_swap, show the summary to the user, then either sign_and_submit (if this server has a wallet) or get_signing_request, sign with the user's wallet, and submit_signatures. Transfers are final.
